svg.aria-label: An isometric map of the RSI science assistant's software. Browser, FastAPI and the Execution Broker sit in a row; the broker connects to the model, Jev, the tools, the trajectory log and the harness, which runs alone in a Docker container. Below them the evolve loop connects graded tasks, an improver model and the folder of harness versions. A lit packet travels the wires to show each step.
